description:
**Site (apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex L954-962)**
\`\`\`elixir
defp render_dequeue_items(items, selected, _width, theme) do
  Enum.with_index(items, fn {type, msg}, idx ->
    ...
    text = if is_map(msg) and Map.has_key?(msg, :content),
             do: to_string(msg.content),
             else: inspect(msg)
    ...
  end)
end
\`\`\`

%OctoPi.AI.Message.User.content can be either a binary OR a list of
%Text{} / %Image{} structs (see apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/message.ex).

When the user steers via Coder.steer (which Message.normalize converts
binaries to a User struct with binary content), to_string works. But
when the source message has list content (e.g. follow-up with images,
or any message reconstructed from session state), to_string raises:
   ** (Protocol.UndefinedError) protocol String.Chars not implemented
   for [%OctoPi.AI.Content.Text{...}]

**Fix**
Use a small helper that handles both:
\`\`\`elixir
defp message_text(%{content: c}) when is_binary(c), do: c
defp message_text(%{content: c}) when is_list(c) do
  c |> Enum.flat_map(fn
    %OctoPi.AI.Content.Text{text: t} -> [t]
    _ -> []
  end) |> Enum.join(\"\\n\")
end
\`\`\`

If we replace the overlay UX with the editor-restore flow (opi-tze.5),
this becomes part of that work.
title: [BUG] Dequeue overlay rendering crashes for list-content user messages
